name: assets_card
description: GH #3894 / REQ-748, docs/assets/asset-register.md section 3, owner decision D-097, decisions 0050 D6, 0051 M4, 0076 R7. The asset card of module assets (Russian: Карточка актива; Kazakh: Актив карточкасы). One row per asset; the card holds no location, no responsible person, no actual user and no quantity: those live only in the register. inventory_number is unique per tenant (uq_assets_card_inventory_number). org_unit_id is the record_id of an org_unit of module org; it is another pack, so it has no foreign key and the write logic checks it. It is the scope column of the card (scope declaration {:column, org_unit_id}, immutable). kind is fixed, low_value or intangible. currency is optional text; the tenant currency is the module setting currency (KZT by default). The decimals are exact strings (decimal_strict) and information only. valid_until is allowed only for kind intangible (write rule, a later step). active false retires the card; there is no delete. external_ref_system and external_ref_id are the nullable import key, unique as a pair.
